faq.name: faq
faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Birth Chart Calculator Questions
faq.description: Clear answers about birth data, calculation methods, free features, privacy, and the limits of astrology.

items.title: What is a birth chart?
items.description: A birth chart, also called a natal chart, is a map of the sky for the date, time, and location of your birth. It shows planetary signs, houses, angles, and relationships called aspects.

items.title: Do I need my exact birth time?
items.description: An exact time is strongly recommended because it affects your Rising sign and house placements. You can still explore a partial chart without it, but some results will be limited.

items.title: Which astrology system does Annora Sky use?
items.description: Annora Sky currently uses Western tropical astrology and Whole Sign houses. Planetary positions are calculated with Astronomy Engine, while your birthplace time zone is used to convert local birth time correctly.

items.title: Is the interpretation written by an astrologer?
items.description: No. Annora Sky is a technology product. Chart positions are calculated deterministically, while interpretation text is generated from documented astrology rules and automated language systems.

items.title: Is the birth chart calculator free?
items.description: Yes. The current free experience includes the chart wheel, Big Three, core planetary placements, major aspects, current transit highlights, and charts saved in this browser.

items.title: How does Annora Sky handle my birth information?
items.description: The current calculator prepares your chart in the browser. Saved chart profiles remain on this device unless a future account feature clearly asks you to sync them.

items.title: Can astrology predict exactly what will happen?
items.description: No. Annora Sky presents astrology as a reflective framework, not certainty. It should never replace professional medical, legal, financial, or mental-health guidance.
